review_scope: Frozen core helper, focused tests, and synthetic logical-byte measurement only. This receipt does not review or admit the pending E520-v7 worker/builder integration, packet, provider action, profile, fit, or score.
findings: The helper hashes complete bytes from an exact canonical-path allowlist, accepts regular files only, checks path and open-descriptor identity before and after the streaming read, and requires the bytes-read count to equal the original size.

A cache entry is installed only from a receipt issued by this handoff after its observed SHA-256 equals both valid lowercase frozen expected and portable-registry SHA-256 values; authorization also re-stats and requires unchanged device, inode, size, mtime, ctime, and mode.

Lookup requires the exact allowlisted canonical path, unchanged current full stat identity, and agreement with the pinned verifier's supplied device/inode/size/mtime/ctime tuple. A stale or changed identity evicts the entry and returns a miss, which calls the pinned original full content digest.

The integration hook wraps only the pinned portability module's _content_digest. The pinned registry identity, registry digest comparison, and all other verifier logic remain in the reviewed source archive; wnn.splits.file_sha256 is not modified. The helper itself does not establish the provenance of caller-supplied expected/registry digest strings, so the worker must preserve and prove the existing source-identity receipt ordering.
The helper is worker-local and memory-only, and a new hash attempt removes any prior authorized entry for that path. There is no cross-worker or cross-attempt digest persistence.

verification.target_hashes: All eight mapped files matched the frozen review-target map.

conditions_for_integrated_review: The E520-v7 integration review must prove the raw inputs remain on the read-only mounted source path for the digest-reuse interval; the helper's stat checks do not lock a mutable file against a concurrent change after lookup's stat.

The worker must persist observed input identity before mismatch handling, authorize only with the existing frozen expected digest and pinned portable-registry digest, retain footer/membership/registry checks, and install the wrapper before the first split load.
The worker/builder/packet must be independently reviewed against its own immutable exact hash map before any provider admission.
